about.ownTranslation: The Russian SRD texts are our own translation and may differ from the original. This app is not an official Wizards of the Coast product.
about.extra: Besides the SRD, the rules reference includes the game mechanics of {{backgrounds}} backgrounds and {{feats}} origin feats, {{subclasses}} subclasses from the Player's Handbook 2024, and {{species}} species from the Player's Handbook 2024 and other books. No book text is used: descriptions are written anew, briefly, in our own words.

createClass.subclassHint: Under the 2014 rules this class chooses its subclass at level 1.

origin.backgroundHint: Gives bonuses to three abilities, a feat, skills and equipment.
origin.subspeciesHint: Lineage, ancestry or legacy — choose one.
origin.versatileHint: A human gains one more origin feat. Skilled is recommended.
origin.spellAbilityHint: It sets the save DC and attack bonus of the spells your species grants.
origin.backgroundHint2014: Gives skills, tools or languages, equipment and a special feature.
origin.variantFeatHint: A variant human gains one feat of your choice. Check feat prerequisites (ability 13+, armor proficiency) yourself.

abilities.valuesHint: Pick a score, then an ability. Tap an assigned one to return it.
abilities.bgHint: The {{background}} background raises {{abilities}}: +2 to one and +1 to another, or +1 to all three. No score above 20.
abilities.raceHint: Ability increases come from your race: {{list}}. No score above 20.
abilities.raceHintNone: Ability increases come from your race — choose it in step 2.

skillsStep.expertiseHint: Your Proficiency Bonus is doubled for these skills.
skillsStep.masteriesHint: Kinds of weapons whose mastery properties you can use. You can change them after a Long Rest.
skillsStep.languagesHint: Everyone knows Common. Choose {{count}} more standard languages.
skillsStep.featureLanguagesHint: You know: {{known}}. Choose {{count}} more — any language, rare ones included.
skillsStep.languagesHint2014: Your race and background give languages of your choice: {{count}}. Any, exotic ones included.

equipmentStep.spellbookHint: Six level 1 spells. You prepare four of them; the rest are in reserve: you can change prepared spells after a Long Rest.

magicInitiate.hint: Two cantrips and one level 1 spell from the chosen list; you can cast the spell once a day without a slot.

sheet.longRestConfirm: Restore all HP, Hit Dice, spell slots and feature uses; remove 1 Exhaustion level?
sheet.passiveInfo: 10 + your Perception skill bonus ({{bonus}}). The GM compares it with creatures’ Stealth and the DC of traps when you aren’t actively searching: if it is equal or higher, you notice.

exhaustion2014.3: disadvantage on checks, attacks and saves, speed halved
exhaustion2014.4: disadvantage, speed and hit point maximum halved
exhaustion2014.5: disadvantage, speed 0, hit point maximum halved

skillsTab.proficienciesHint: Mark a language learned during play in “Edit”.

combat.sneakHint: Once per turn, with Advantage or an ally next to the target
combat.critHint: An attack is a {{d20}} roll; on a natural 20 tap “Critical” in the damage panel: damage dice are rolled twice.
combat.masteriesHint: Kinds of weapons whose mastery properties you use. You can change them after a Long Rest.
combat.rageActive: Raging: +{{bonus}} damage on Strength attacks (and Unarmed Strikes).
combat.smiteHint: Bonus Action right after you hit with a Melee weapon or an Unarmed Strike.
combat.smiteFreeHint: Paladin’s Smite: once per Long Rest without a slot. Left: {{left}}.
combat.smiteFreeUsed: The free Smite is already used. It returns after a Long Rest.
combat.offhandNote: A Bonus Action after attacking with a Light weapon, using a different Light weapon. Don’t add your ability modifier to the damage unless it is negative (with Two-Weapon Fighting you do).

magic.noneHint: This character can't cast spells yet.
magic.noSlotsHint: No free spell slots of level {{level}} or higher are left.
magic.slotsHint: A filled circle is a spent slot. Tap to spend or restore.
magic.initiateHint: You can cast the level 1 spell once a day without a slot (track it yourself for now).
magic.speciesHint: Always prepared. Once per Long Rest without a slot (Forest Gnome: as many times as your Proficiency Bonus); you can also use a slot.
magic.swapCantripHint: After a Long Rest you can replace this cantrip with another Wizard cantrip.
magic.invocationsHint: Tap an invocation to read it. “No slot” invocation spells can be cast any number of times; Book of Shadows spells are prepared Warlock spells.
magic.metamagicHint: Track Sorcery Points in Resources on the Sheet tab. Tap an option to read it.
magic.spellbookHint: You can cast rituals from your book as Rituals without preparing them. Change prepared spells after a Long Rest via “Edit spells”.
magic.beamsNote: Beams: {{count}}. Each has its own attack roll; roll damage for each beam that hits.
magic.dartsNote: Darts: {{count}} — total of all darts; split it if they hit different targets.
magic.chosenType: You choose the damage type when casting.
magic.pactSlotsHint: Warlock Pact Magic: separate slots, regained on a Short Rest. They can cast spells of your other classes too.

edit.name: Name
edit.languagesHint: Mark the languages the character learned during play.
edit.fileHint: You can send the .dnd.json file to a friend or keep it as a backup; open it with the “Import” button on the “My Characters” screen.

inventory.acNow: Current AC: {{ac}}. Worn armor and shield count toward AC.

levelUpPage.hpHint: The Hit Die average + Constitution modifier (plus bonuses from feats and features).
levelUpPage.asi: Ability Score Improvement or a feat
levelUpPage.asiHint: Ability Score Improvement: +2 to one or +1 to two (no higher than 20). Or another feat.
levelUpPage.expertiseHint: Your Proficiency Bonus is doubled for these skills.
levelUpPage.whichClassHint: Your class or a new one (multiclassing). A new class needs 13+ in the primary ability of the new class and all of yours.
levelUpPage.multiclassHint: When multiclassing, the new class grants only some proficiencies: {{list}}. Hit points per level are average; saving throws don’t change.

classOptions.invocationHint: You gain more invocations as a Warlock; on level up you can replace one. “?” shows the description.
classOptions.metamagicHint: Ways to modify spells with Sorcery Points. On level up you can replace one option. “?” shows the description.
classOptions.tomeHint: From any class’s spell list. While the book is on you, they are prepared and count as Warlock spells.

edition.title: Rules edition
edition.hint2024: 2024 rules (SRD 5.2): ability bonuses and a feat come from your background.
edition.hint2014: 2014 rules (SRD 5.1): ability increases come from your race; the background has its own feature.
edition.changeWarning: Changing the edition restarts the draft (the name is kept).
